headline: Walker sits, Johnson carries, Arizona still has to be finished at 16.5

sectionTitles.lastGame: Atlanta's 35-13, read as context not the assignment
sectionTitles.currentState: Seed math with a backfield and a trench question
sectionTitles.gamePlan: Arizona at Arrowhead: finish a 3-7 club without getting cute
sectionTitles.pressConferences: Podium notes ahead of Sun Nov 22

dek: Kansas City is 7-2 and hosts Arizona on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT on CBS as a DraftKings 16.5-point favorite on a 40.5 total, with Kenneth Walker III out and the Mercedes-Benz tape still at 4-of-13 on third down.
videoHook: Arizona is the 16.5 at Arrowhead, Walker is out, and the Atlanta tape still has a third-down hole Andy Reid cannot ignore.
theEdge: ESPN FPI has Kansas City at 88.5 percent to beat Arizona at home, with DraftKings at minus 16.5 on a 40.5 total — a heavy favorite whose Atlanta line was 22-of-35 for 348 yards and five touchdowns, one sack taken, eight quarterback hits, and 4-of-13 on third down.

Emmett Johnson 22 rushes + 6 catches = 28 touches. Nate Carter 2 rushes + 0 catches = 2 touches. Do not attach 28 to Carter.
Mahomes 1 sack. Penix 3 sacks. Karlaftis 1.5 sacks. KC QB hits 5; hits on Mahomes 8. Team net pass 339, Mahomes passing yards 348. KC TOP 28:36, ATL TOP 31:24.

storyline.lede: The assignment on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT is Arizona at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, a DraftKings 16.5-point price on a 40.5 total, with ESPN FPI giving Kansas City an 88.5 percent chance. Arizona is 3-7, has lost consecutive games, and has moved on from Marvin Harrison Jr. Kansas City is 7-2, tied with Denver atop the AFC West and one game behind Buffalo for the AFC's No. 1 seed. The favorite's own tape from Atlanta is the caution: 461 yards and five touchdowns, and still 4-of-13 on third down with eight quarterback hits on Patrick Mahomes.
body: Kenneth Walker III will not play after missing practice with a groin injury, so the run plan cannot be a committee fantasy. Emmett Johnson just handled 22 carries for 101 yards and six catches — 28 touches — while Nate Carter had two rushes and two touches. Eric Bieniemy can spell Johnson. He cannot pretend Carter's two touches were the Atlanta workload.

Andy Reid's staff also has a trench issue that Arrowhead Addict framed as mounting offensive-line injuries, and Arrowhead Pride's final report ruled three Kansas City starters out. The wire names Walker. It does not name the other two. That is enough to treat protection as a live problem: Mahomes was 22-of-35 for 348 yards, five touchdowns and a 135.5 rating, with one sack and eight quarterback hits. Explosive throws covered the stalls. They did not erase them.

Steve Spagnuolo's group gets a 3-7 offense that has been losing, not a free week. Atlanta still held the ball 31:24 to Kansas City's 28:36, ran for 100 yards, and put 370 total yards on the sheet before two turnovers.

lastGameReview.label: Week 10 · Sun, Nov 15 · 12:00 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City beat Atlanta 35-13 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, scoring on a 12-yard touchdown at Q1 8:53 — 6:07 into the game — and finishing with five touchdowns to Atlanta's one. The visitors piled up 461 yards and zero turnovers. They also went 4-of-13 on third down and gave the ball back often enough that Atlanta ran 15 drives to Kansas City's 13.

analysis.body: The scoreboard ran away late more than it ran away early. Atlanta's 3-yard touchdown at Q4 8:12 and 38-yard field goal at Q4 6:45 cut it to 28-13 before Andrew Armstrong's 43-yard touchdown at Q4 4:18 made it 35-13.

Xavier Worthy was targeted deep and those listed throws were incomplete. Travis Kelce, who returned in the second quarter, finished with two catches. This was a shot-play passing day, not a third-down machine. Kansas City was 4-of-13; Atlanta was 5-of-16.

Johnson was the run game. He carried 22 times for 101 of the team 122 rushing yards on 27 attempts, with listed gains up the middle and at both ends, including an 11-yard right-end run and an 18-yard left-tackle run that A.J. Terrell forced out of bounds. That fumble did not become a turnover — the box lists zero for Kansas City. Justin Fields's direct-snap rush went for no gain. Carter had two rushes. Mahomes added two rushes, including a 9-yard scramble up the middle.

Atlanta's 100 rushing yards on 20 attempts were mostly Bijan Robinson (16 rushes and four catches, 20 touches), with a 17-yard run up the middle and an 8-yard left-end carry. Penix was 23-of-43 for a 64.7 rating, took three sacks, and was hit as part of Kansas City's five quarterback hits. Drake London caught six passes, including 38 yards. Jahan Dotson had a 37-yard catch. Kyle Pitts Sr. had a 28-yard catch and was in on the strip: N. Bolton forced the fumble, C. Conner recovered at the Atlanta 44. N. Williams intercepted Penix on a deep-middle throw intended for Chris Blair and returned it 20 yards. An earlier Penix fumble was aborted and recovered by Penix. Kansas City also failed on downs at Q4 3:39.

takeaways.title: Explosives covered a bad down-and-distance day
takeaways.body: Five touchdowns and 461 yards will travel in the highlights. The 4-of-13 third-down line is what Bieniemy has to answer before a 16.5 price makes fans assume every series will finish. Atlanta still possessed the ball for 31:24.

takeaways.title: The backfield load is already Johnson's
takeaways.body: Johnson's 28 touches — 22 rushes and six catches — produced 101 rushing yards inside a 122-yard team total. Carter's line was two touches. With Walker out, that split is the roster fact, not a one-week curiosity.

takeaways.title: The defense closed with two credited takeaways
takeaways.body: N. Bolton forced and C. Conner recovered the Pitts fumble.

whatWorked: Mahomes at 22-of-35, 348 yards, five touchdowns, 135.5, one sack, zero team turnovers.
whatDidnt: Third down at 4-of-13, and a turnover on downs on an incomplete to Allen.
Eight quarterback hits on Mahomes against one sack — pressure without a collapse, still a protection note.
Johnson's fumble, forced by A.J. Terrell and out of bounds, plus Atlanta holding the clock at 31:24 and gaining 370 yards.

currentState.lede: Kansas City is 7-2 and back at Arrowhead for Arizona, tied with Denver in the AFC West and one game behind Buffalo in the race for the No. 1 seed. Two straight games have ended 35-13 and 35-12. The next one is priced like a get-ahead week. The roster says it is a manage-the-bodies week.

workOn.title: Third down before the price makes it optional
workOn.body: A 16.5 favorite that keeps handing the ball back lets a 3-7 team stay in the script longer than the number suggests, and Buffalo is on the calendar four days after this kickoff.

workOn.title: Johnson's touches without burning him for Thursday
workOn.body: Walker is out. Johnson just played 28 touches. Carter has a two-touch line to grow into a spell, not a 28-touch job. Bieniemy needs early-down efficiency so the closer is the score, not another 22-carry afternoon stacked onto a short week.

workOn.title: Protection with the trench report incomplete in public
workOn.body: Eight hits and one sack on Mahomes in Atlanta is the verified pressure line. Three starters are ruled out and the wire has not named the offensive linemen. Reid should plan as if the pocket is shorter, not as if the Falcons rush was a one-off.

thinkAbout.title: How seriously to treat 88.5 percent
thinkAbout.body: FPI and the 16.5 say Arizona is the lesser side, and a 3-7 team that has moved on from Marvin Harrison Jr. deserves that read. The same model does not play third down or replace Walker. The edge is real. The margin for a sloppy series is not 16.5 points of comfort.

thinkAbout.title: Whether Justin Reid is a this-week topic or a later one
thinkAbout.body: The Saints granted Justin Reid's release request. Arrowhead Addict frames a reunion as tempting. That is a front-office question, not a snap-count answer for Arizona. Spagnuolo's current secondary just produced the N. Williams interception and the Conner recovery.

gamePlan.lede: Host a 3-7 Arizona team on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT on CBS, lay 16.5, and leave Arrowhead healthy enough for Buffalo on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT. The Cardinals have lost consecutive games and no longer have Marvin Harrison Jr. They are also described in the wire as injury-depleted. Credit the record. Do not gift them hidden explosives by playing loose on third down.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Kansas City's offense just produced 461 yards, five touchdowns, and a 135.5 passer rating, with the run game concentrated in Johnson. Arizona's season has been losses, a departed No. 1 receiver, and a depleted injury sheet. The mismatch is real: FPI 88.5 percent, DraftKings minus 16.5. The leverage Arizona can actually hold is pace and Kansas City's own 4-of-13, plus whatever pass rush shows up against an offensive line the club has not fully clarified. Spagnuolo should still expect a full game script. Atlanta gained 370 yards and held a 31:24 possession edge in a 22-point loss.

keys.title: Score on early downs so third down is not the offense
keys.body: Johnson on inside zone and Mahomes's easy answers — screens and mesh — should turn 1st-and-10 into 2nd-and-short. The Atlanta miss was finishing drives without an 18-, 39-, or 43-yard throw. Arizona should not be allowed to live on Kansas City's 4-of-13 habit.

keys.title: Keep the deep menu, change who has to win it
keys.body: Downs, Allen, Armstrong, and Rice all produced explosives in Atlanta. Worthy was targeted deep without a completion on the listed throws. With Harrison gone, Arizona's coverage picture is thinner on paper. Bieniemy can still stress it vertically without asking Mahomes to hold the ball into eight hits.

keys.title: Rush the passer, then tackle the checkdown
keys.body: Rally tackles matter because a 3-7 offense will try to live underneath once the deep shot is capped.

keys.title: Win the game without a 28-touch sequel if the score allows
keys.body: Walker is unavailable. Johnson is the starter. If Kansas City is comfortably ahead, Carter's two-touch role can grow on inside zone and screens so Thursday in Buffalo is not a recovery week for the lead back.

script: Open with Johnson on early-down inside zone and a Mahomes keep or scramble rule, the same family as the 9-yard up-the-middle scramble, so Arizona cannot sit on one back.
On 2nd-and-long, throw the spacing screen to Johnson — six catches last game — and let the line get to space instead of asking Mahomes to absorb another hit cluster.
Use mesh for Kelce and Rice against man looks, with Downs as the sit/corner piece that scored from 18.
Take a four-verticals shot once the box commits to Johnson, aiming the seams at Rice and Allen, who scored from 39.
Spagnuolo in Cover-2 on early Arizona downs to cap the deep middle Penix found with London, Dotson, and Pitts.
Call the zone blitz on obvious passing downs, with a lineman dropping and Karlaftis as a possible second-level rusher — a call, tied to no takeaway from last week.

spotlight.title: Johnson's 28 touches are the plan Walker cannot share
spotlight.body: ESPN says Kenneth Walker III will not play against the Cardinals after a groin injury kept him out of practice. Johnson's Atlanta line was 22 carries, 101 yards, and six catches. Carter's line was two touches. That is the rotation until the report changes.

spotlight.title: 16.5 is a finish test, not a coronation
spotlight.body: FPI's 88.5 percent and a 40.5 total say Arizona is not built to trade scores. Arrowhead Pride still has Kansas City tied with Denver and one back of Buffalo. A sloppy 4-of-13 day at home would waste the seed math even in a win.

spotlight.title: Justin Reid is available, not signed
spotlight.body: The Saints granted his release request. Arrowhead Pride and Arrowhead Addict both noted the old Kansas City tie. It is a debate for Brett Veach, not a lineup note for Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run game vs. Arizona front
matchups.chiefs: Emmett Johnson, with Nate Carter in a two-touch spell and Kenneth Walker III out
matchups.opponent: Arizona's injury-depleted front, no Walker-level counter on the Kansas City side
matchups.note: Team rush in Atlanta was 122 on 27 attempts, 101 of it from Johnson. The edge holds if the line that is banged up can still reach the second level.

matchups.unit: Mahomes and the receivers vs. Arizona coverage
matchups.chiefs: Patrick Mahomes, Rashee Rice, Josh Downs, Cyrus Allen, Andrew Armstrong
matchups.opponent: A Cardinals defense no longer pairing with Marvin Harrison Jr. on the other sideline, and a secondary that has lived in losses
matchups.note: 22-of-35, 348 yards, five touchdowns in Atlanta. The miss is third down, not the vertical menu.

matchups.unit: Kansas City protection vs. Arizona pass rush
matchups.chiefs: Patrick Mahomes behind an offensive line the final report has not fully named in public
matchups.opponent: Whatever rush Arizona brings into a week Arrowhead Addict says could be thin in the trenches for Kansas City
matchups.note: One sack and eight quarterback hits is not a broken pocket and not a clean one. Treat it as even until the unnamed starters are clarified.

matchups.unit: Chiefs pass rush vs. Arizona offense
matchups.chiefs: George Karlaftis and Steve Spagnuolo's pressure menu
matchups.opponent: A 3-7 offense that has lost consecutive games
matchups.note: Karlaftis had 1.5 sacks against Atlanta, where the opponent quarterback took three sacks and Kansas City recorded five quarterback hits. That is form, not a promise.

matchups.opponent: Arizona's best path is Kansas City handing the ball back
matchups.note: 4-of-13 is the honest edge for the underdog. Explosives hid it in a 35-13 win. A lower-total game (40.5) punishes empty series more.

xsandos.title: Johnson inside zone on early downs
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 at Arrowhead, Walker inactive, Arizona loading to the passing strength after a 348-yard Mahomes tape
xsandos.why: Johnson just turned 22 carries into 101 yards inside a 122-yard team day. With Walker out, the downhill carry is how Bieniemy keeps third down from becoming another 4-of-13. Carter can rotate in; his Atlanta line was two touches, so he is the spell, not the identity.
xsandos.coaching: Zone steps, one cut, get to the second level before the price invites Arizona to sell out on Mahomes. Reid should live here on 1st-and-10 so the 16.5 is played, not announced.

playmakers.name: Nate Carter
playmakers.role: spell back on a later series

xsandos.title: Spacing screen when the hits show up
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-7-plus after Arizona shows a four-man rush, with Mahomes coming off eight quarterback hits and one sack
xsandos.why: The Atlanta pocket was noisy without being a sack day. A screen to Johnson, who caught six passes, lets the line lead and takes the ball out of a collapsing pocket before another hit. Armstrong's blocking reputation in the Arrowhead Addict note fits the perimeter help.
xsandos.coaching: Throw it on rhythm. Do not hold for a second read. The point is to punish a rush that is trying to recreate those eight hits, and to give Carter a catch path if Johnson needs a series off.

xsandos.title: Mesh for Kelce and Rice
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-medium, the down Kansas City lost too often in Atlanta (4-of-13), against man coverage
xsandos.why: Rice had five catches for 82 yards and a 50-yard gain. Kelce had two catches after returning to the Atlanta game. Rubs give Mahomes a throw before the rush, which matters more with unnamed starters out up front than another deep dropback.
xsandos.coaching: Crossers have to be tight. Kelce sits if the linebacker runs through. Rice continues. Downs is the sit option that already scored from 18 on a different concept — here he is the check, not the shot.

xsandos.title: Four verticals once the box commits
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-short after Johnson has moved the chains, Arizona walked up to stop the run
xsandos.why: Allen's 39-yard touchdown, Armstrong's 43-yard touchdown, Downs's 18-yard score, and Rice's 50-yard catch are the vertical proof. Harrison is no longer Arizona's problem on offense, but the coverage still has to account for four Chiefs who just got behind Atlanta. Worthy remains a vertical option after incomplete deep targets, not a guaranteed target share.
xsandos.coaching: Seams bend to the hash. Outsides run past the corners. Mahomes throws on time — one sack and eight hits means this is a shot, not a scramble drill.

xsandos.title: Cover-2 to take the deep middle
xsandos.situation: Arizona 1st-and-10 and 2nd-and-long, where a trailing 3-7 offense will hunt a shot to stay inside 16.5
xsandos.why: Atlanta completed deep to London (38), Dotson (37), and Pitts (28) even while losing 35-13. Spagnuolo cannot assume a depleted Cardinals offense will refuse the same middle. Two deep, five under, rally and tackle.
xsandos.coaching: Corners sink. Safeties stay on top of the hashes. Linebackers, including N. Bolton, fit the checkdown so a capped shot does not become a 15-yard catch-and-run. This shell is the call. It is not an explanation of any Atlanta takeaway.

xsandos.title: Zone blitz on obvious passing downs
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-6 or longer, Arizona in the shotgun, Kansas City ahead and trying to end the series
xsandos.why: Karlaftis already has a 1.5-sack Atlanta line, and the defense recorded five quarterback hits while the opposing quarterback took three sacks. A simulated pressure — show heat, drop a lineman, rush a second-level player — is the call Spagnuolo can use so Arizona's protection picks the wrong four. It is a plan for this week, not a claim about how either Atlanta takeaway happened.
xsandos.coaching: Disguise the dropper. Karlaftis can be the adder or the occupier depending on the protection count. The coverage behind it has to be zone, because a 3-7 quarterback will throw hot if the picture is man.
